# Glade — Governance that learns

> A decision-centric governance platform for social purpose organisations.

Glade treats governance decisions as the primary unit of organisational memory — traceable, reviewable, connected to living governance documents.

## What Glade does

- **Decision log**: Every governance decision recorded with context — who decided, how, why, and what happened next. Tagged, linked, searchable.
- **Living documents**: Governance documents (constitutions, policies, terms of reference) that trace back to the decisions that shaped them. Full version history.
- **Structured proposals**: A clear path from idea to decision, with discussion, amendment, and resolution.
- **Learning loops**: Scheduled reviews that help organisations learn from their own governance history.
- **Live meeting mode**: Facilitation tools that capture decisions as a natural byproduct of running a meeting. Consent rounds, voting, advice process.
- **AI governance insights**: Pattern analysis, review questions, document impact suggestions, governance digests, and new member briefings.

## Who it's for

Glade is built for charities, CICs, cooperatives, partnerships, and other social purpose organisations that want to govern better — not just comply.

## Decision methods supported

- Consent (adopted unless paramount objection)
- Advice Process (individual decides after consulting affected parties)
- Consensus (full agreement from everyone present)
- Majority Vote (simple majority carries)
- Delegation (authority granted within constraints)
- Lazy Consensus (silence means agreement, time-boxed)

## Pricing

- **Seedling** (Free): 5 members, 50 decisions, 1 space. Decision log, documents, proposals, topics.
- **Canopy** (£15/month or £144/year): 25 members, unlimited decisions, unlimited spaces. AI insights, live meeting mode, priority support.
- **Old Growth** (Custom): Unlimited everything. Dedicated support, custom integrations.
